name: glass-cards
description: Liquid / frosted glass cards for Home Assistant dashboards. Fast, themeable without card_mod.

scripts.build: node scripts/demo-dashboard.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && vite build && node scripts/copy-wallpapers.mjs && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.build:web: node scripts/demo-dashboard.mjs && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && mkdir -p dist-web/assets/wallpapers && cp wallpapers/hills-day.jpg wallpapers/hills-night-blue-soft.jpg dist-web/assets/wallpapers/
